summary: PLAN_ID toolchain-workflow-repair; validates plan directory under execution-plans and required artifacts; contract must be self-hosted with slices W0-W6 and TDD metadata; registry requires plan-ready, terminal-full, and green/terminal commands per slice; authority manifest partitions sources, candidates, lifecycle projections; repair modes require implementation-authorized state plus round-1 validating/closed state, execution blocking only preclose, no authorizations; draft and plan-ready states have publication constraints; resume and all receipts must authorize nothing; architecture acceptance required; baseline commit 2556ea78f41657e5a740016ff97da0b0614631ea and candidate a2ded39b0f67dcbe5f27acedb56c0bafbd3f3fc5 are fixed; seven expected delta paths require git-bound hashes and regression disposition; canonical skill-input receipt is mandatory, inside plan, and must validate ready; knowledge preflight ready, freeze unprivileged, accepted modules skill-input-execution and knowledge-execution-gates; emits pass/fail validation JSON, optional input manifest, lifecycle transition none; invalid or missing artifacts accumulate failure identifiers; ambiguity: plan-state.v1.json is read although absent from required-files set
